dead_ms.why: pulse decode + internal loop delay; no datasheet value; M8 bench step

tau_s.why: small-signal position-loop lag; M8 (scope the pot or a pointer on video)

deadband_us.why: 3 us [A17 value kept, A32 lists none]; up to 5 us for a worn or cheaper unit [A]

w0_dps_at_6v5.why: 60 deg / 0.1833 s at 6.5 V, interpolated 0.20 s @5.0 / 0.18 s @6.8 V [S A32]; +/-14 % unit spread [A]

tstall_nm_at_6v5.why: 29.33 kg*cm at 6.5 V interpolated from 26 @5.0 / 30 @6.8 [S A32]; -13/+11 % unit spread [A]

istall_a.why: 3.99 A sizing [D actuation_trade.md, A32]; 3.75 A datasheet at 6.5 V (3.5 @5.0, 3.8 @6.8 [S A32]) to 4.8 A for a +20 % unit [A]

droop_deg_at_stall.why: error at which the servo reaches full duty; dyno.md uses 3 deg [A]

v_set.why: 6.5 +/- 0.15 V buck [S torque_and_actuator.md section 3.2, Douglas ruling]

r_src_ohm.why: buck output + wiring + connector resistance; scope M (R27 proof)

r_c_mm.why: pivot to pad line of action [DB D3]

backlash_deg.why: j_t 0.25 mm (0.16-0.34) = 1.01 deg at the jaw [D gears.md, printed PA6-CF pick]

k_tip_n_per_mm.why: R12 window 0.88-1.63 [DB R12]; FEA pick 1.10 [D fea_summary / dyno.md]

k_mismatch.why: finger A vs B stiffness mismatch (print-to-print); M10 on both fingers

f_fold_n.why: FEA limit load: 8.88 N bare at E 56, 8.41 N with the PLA nail, 10.6 N at E 67 [D finger.md 5.2]

plies.why: one ply is the scenario (DB section 6); 2-4 for seams and folds [A]

ply_mm.why: 0.3 mm [DB M4 default]; 0.2-0.5 mm for shirting to denim [A]

k_ply_n_per_mm.why: through-thickness stiffness of one ply under the pad; dyno.md uses 30 [A]

phi_compact.why: fraction of the stack thickness that can compress before the fibres lock

span_part.why: FSR 400 part-to-part repeatability +/-6 % (single batch) [S Interlink FSR 400 page]

span_mount.why: residual error after CALF <N> (M11) on the TPU pad backing; 0.5-1.5 if CALF is skipped

fsr_exp_err.why: power-law exponent error vs the Adafruit-table fit (fsr_model.h)

drift_per_dec.why: creep < 5 % per log10(time) at constant load [S Interlink FSR 400 page]

hyst.why: +5 to +10 % (reads high on unloading) [S Interlink datasheet PDS-10004; distributor listing]

v33_mv.why: ESP32 3V3 LDO tolerance +/-1.8 %; the firmware assumes 3300

zero_mv.why: unloaded node offset (preload from the pad backing)

adc_sat_mv.why: 11 dB attenuation reads saturate near 3.1 V

frame_phase_ms.why: phase of the servo's frame against the firmware control tick (uniform)

backdrive_factor.why: motor torque below which the held load back-drives the gear train, / the torque to close: eta_g^2, eta_g 0.65 [A dyno.md], 0.5-0.8 [thermal.md 4.4]; what F1 exploits

disc_conduction.why: servo drive conduction: 0 continuous (rail I = I_m (I_m / I_stall + w / w0)), 1 discontinuous (rail I = I_m) [thermal.md 0: unmeasured; the F4 hold reading decides]

early_contact_deg.why: contact this far above theta_c0 (a fold, a seam stack or an object, rigid: 2.27 mm of extra stack per deg); 0 unless a run draws it (--early) [A, O9]
